name: Triumvirate
detailed_description:
Disclaimer: Please note that Triumvirate does NOT have public matchmaking nor does it have single-player. Please DO NOT buy the game if you don't have enough players to form a session. The minimum player count to start a game is 3.

The Triumvirate has been tasked with the management of a grand new city. People flock from all over for the promise of a glorious utopia. Immigration is at a record-breaking high, expansion at an all-time speed. The unrelenting force of growth will cause the inevitable collapse of the city. 

Triumvirate is better described as a city-administration game than a city-builder. How long can you and your friends keep the city afloat?

Dynamic Player Count

3 to 6 players manage one or two government departments each, depending on the size of the lobby. Each department has unique starting bonuses. Try them all out!

Divided Tasks

Each department has unique tasks to complete to either sustain the city, or boost its prosperity. Everyone needs to succeed for the city to prosper.

The Department of Agriculture and Infrastructure keeps the city from starving, and directs the supply of goods. 

The Department of Industry and Finance manufactures export goods, and manages the yearly budget of the other departments.

The Department of Defense and Labor to suppress insurrections, and audits the citizens to ensure compliance.

Collaboration

Some tasks have requirements that can only be fulfilled by other departments. Communicate with your friends or you may struggle to develop your city districts.

Dictate laws, create buildings, start special programs, complain to your friends regarding their law choices, and more.

Stylized Art

An abstract representation of your city keeps things tidy and performant for lower end systems. Watch as your city expands and grows.

short_description: Triumvirate is a fast-paced 3-6 player cooperative city-management strategy game. Work together to meet the demands of a rapidly growing metropolis to avoid the inevitability of overextension.
